name: motion-native
description: Premation native core: test + bench dependencies by default; the `engine` feature adds Dawn for premation-engine (C1, docs/VIEWPORT_ROUTE.md).

engine.description: premation-engine: E3 text + vector (Skia CPU raster built with clang-cl through native/vcpkg-overlays/skia, FreeType + woff2 fonts, HarfBuzz shaping, SheenBidi UAX #9) + OpenColorIO (D3 colour management) +ffmpeg (E1 decode: avcodec/avformat/swscale, dav1d, libvpx for VP9 alpha; hwaccels d3d11va/d3d12va/dxva2 on Windows, videotoolbox on macOS, nvdec where nvcodec is offered, vulkan on Linux) + miniaudio (E2 audio output: header-only; WASAPI / CoreAudio / ALSA-PulseAudio) + Dawn (native WebGPU) with only the backend each OS ships — D3D12 / Metal / Vulkan. Enable with VCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=engine (the *-engine presets).
